function.name: get_emf_physdev
function.description: This function returns the containing record of the given PHYSDEV device in the form of an EMFDRV_PDEVICE pointer.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: The PHYSDEV device for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: EMFDRV_PDEVICE pointer, representing the containing record of the given PHYSDEV device.

function.name: emfdrv_update_bounds
function.description: This function updates the bounds of a given rectangle based on the device context. It handles potential mirroring of the coordinate systems.

parameters.name: dc
parameters.description: Device context which contains the attributes and bounds to be updated

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Rectangle whose bounds are to be updated

function.return_type: void, does not return anything

function.name: EMFDRV_LineTo
function.description: This function updates the bounds of a device context based on the given x and y coordinates, and always returns TRUE.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: This is the x-coordinate.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: This is the y-coordinate.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function executed successfully. Always returns TRUE in this case.

function.name: EMFDRV_RoundRect
function.description: This function updates the bounds of a rectangle in a device context, if the rectangle's sides are not equal. It also adjusts the bounds if the graphics mode is GM_COMPATIBLE.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: The device context

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The left coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The top coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The right coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The bottom coordinate of the rectangle

parameters.name: ell_width
parameters.description: The width of the ellipse used to round off the corners of the rectangle

parameters.name: ell_height
parameters.description: The height of the ellipse used to round off the corners of the rectangle

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the bounds were successfully updated, FALSE otherwise

function.name: EMFDRV_ArcChordPie
function.description: This function draws an arc, chord, or pie shape in a device context. It calculates the bounding box for the shape, updates the bounds, and returns a boolean value.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context to draw in

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Left coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Top coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: Right coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: Bottom coordinate of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: X coordinate of the start point of the arc

parameters.name: ystart
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the start point of the arc

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: X coordinate of the end point of the arc

parameters.name: yend
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the end point of the arc

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of shape to draw (arc, chord, or pie)

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully draws the shape, and FALSE otherwise

function.name: EMFDRV_Arc
function.description: This function is used to draw an arc in a device context. It calls the EMFDRV_ArcChordPie function with the EMR_ARC parameter.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context where the arc will be drawn.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle for the arc.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle for the arc.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle for the arc.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle for the arc.

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the first radial ending point of the arc.

parameters.name: ystart
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the first radial ending point of the arc.

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the second radial ending point of the arc.

parameters.name: yend
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the second radial ending point of the arc.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the arc was successfully drawn or not.

function.name: EMFDRV_ArcTo
function.description: This function is used to draw an arc in a specified rectangle from the start point to the end point.

parameters.name: dev

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the rectangle

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the start point of the arc

parameters.name: ystart
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the start point of the arc

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the end point of the arc

parameters.name: yend
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the end point of the arc

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the arc was successfully drawn or not

function.name: EMFDRV_Pie
function.description: This function is used to draw a pie shape on a device context.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context where the pie shape will be drawn.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the first point of the radial line defining the starting point of the pie.

parameters.name: ystart
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the first point of the radial line defining the starting point of the pie.

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the second point of the radial line defining the ending point of the pie.

function.name: EMFDRV_Chord
function.description: This function is used to draw a chord in a device context. It uses the EMFDRV_ArcChordPie function to do so.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context where the chord will be drawn.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle.

parameters.name: xstart
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the starting point of the chord.

parameters.name: ystart

parameters.name: xend
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the ending point of the chord.

parameters.name: yend

function.name: EMFDRV_Ellipse
function.description: This function draws an ellipse on a device context. It calculates the bounds of the ellipse, updates them if the graphics mode is GM_COMPATIBLE, and updates the bounds in the device context.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: The device context on which the ellipse is to be drawn

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the lower-right corner of the bounding rectangle

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the ellipse was successfully drawn, and FALSE if the specified bounding rectangle is invalid

function.name: EMFDRV_Rectangle
function.description: This function checks if the rectangle parameters are valid, adjusts the rectangle bounds based on the graphics mode, updates the bounds, and returns a boolean value indicating the success of the operation.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This parameter represents the physical device.

parameters.name: right
parameters.description: This parameter represents the right coordinate of the rectangle.

parameters.name: bottom
parameters.description: This parameter represents the bottom coordinate of the rectangle.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the rectangle parameters are valid and the bounds are successfully updated, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: EMFDRV_SelectFont
function.description: This function selects a font for a device context, disables anti-aliasing on metafiles and returns the selected font.

parameters.description: This is the device context for which the font is being selected.

parameters.name: font

parameters.name: cap
parameters.description: This represents the index of the capability to be retrieved from the device.

function.return_type: INT, represents the capability of the device at the specified index. If the index is out of range, it returns 0.

parameters.name: cap

function.name: NtGdiCreateMetafileDC
function.description: This function creates a metafile device context (DC), which is used to record a sequence of GDI function calls. The recorded sequence can later be played back to reproduce the original drawing operations.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: This parameter is a handle to an existing device context. If this parameter is NULL, the function uses the current display device for reference.

function.return_type: HDC. It returns a handle to the metafile device context if the function is successful. If it fails, the return value is zero.
